mechanism: Valproic acid impairs biotin metabolism and increases urinary biotin excretion, leading to biotin deficiency which may contribute to hair loss and skin manifestations in chronic valproic acid users.
action: Monitor for signs of biotin deficiency (alopecia, dermatitis, brittle nails) in chronic valproic acid users; consider biotin supplementation (5-10 mg daily) particularly in patients on long-term therapy.
